description: Opens a merge request (GitHub pull request) with the uncommitted changes of a repository in an allowed folder with write access, e.g. core_dump: creates a new branch, commits all changes, pushes it and opens the pull request into the default branch. Use it only when the change is complete and clean: make builds with no errors or warnings, make check passes, and doxy reports no documentation problems. Do not commit with git yourself first. It then waits for the merge gate and returns the quiz link the reviewer must pass. It never merges; a person reviews the request.

params.name: path
params.description: The repository folder, starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump

params.name: title
params.description: Title: what the change does, e.g. Add an e module that prints Euler's number

params.name: body
params.description: Description for the reviewer: what changed, why, and how it was checked (e.g. make builds without warnings)

params.name: branch
params.description: Branch name to create; omit it to derive one from the title (agent/...)
